exact_statement: Version7 preserves the explicit endpoint/envelope conclusions of A030@5/@6 and clarifies their cost scope. For every finite adaptive uniform physical restriction tree with normalized support-positive current output references, let d_v be current KL, e_vs inherited-child KL under the actual output phase channel, L_v=d_v-E_s e_vs>=0 and kappa_v=E_s(d_vs-e_vs). Then CE_root+sum_v w_v kappa_v=H_root+E_leaf d_leaf+sum_v w_v L_v; the entropy-path plus full terminal CE functional T is H_root+E_leaf d_leaf. For every k,L>=1 the actual two-source selector F_k,L of PROOF.md, made from products of k two-bit point defects and their first-coordinate translates with fresh length-L parity blocks, has H=2k,I=Lk+1/2. Its block-data-first then selector tree has max current KL1, raw replacement sum k, query-KL sum k+1, and raw transaction3k+1. Selector-first has raw replacement sum0, query-KL sum1 and transaction2k+1, with the same singleton physical leaf partition. At every restriction fixing q<=d<L distinct coordinates, on every assignment, H=2k,I=Lk+1/2-q/2 and all live influences are1/2. Thus these bounded-depth H/influence statistics do not distinguish the policies; CURRENT KL or the source decomposition does. A final x-block query has zero entropy drop and one bit of actual query-KL contraction. No constant depending only on label count2 bounds accumulated query KL. Earlier tagged-bent >3/16 and >1/4 reserve statements remain for T or an explicitly credited L ledger; an uncredited raw-transaction interpretation requires separate SAME-owner payment of sum w L. This is not an FEI disproof or a refutation of the earlier numerical rate4 quota. Universal arbitrary-core admission and raw query-KL payment remain open.
